simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to תִּפְתַּי (H8614) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-m.

simple.summary: תִּפְתַּי (tiphtay) means judicial , i.e. a lawyer First listed occurrence: Dan 3 2.

definitions.full: H8614. tiphtaye תִּפְתָּיֵא Kt, תָּאֵי - Qr, noun masculine plural name of the official Dan 3:2-3 ,(so Egyptian Aramaic RÉS 361B 4 וגושכיא תיפתיא דיניא ; meaning unknown, conjectures in Bev, Behrm, compare Dr). [ תַּקִּיף ] see תְּקִף . below
